title: Smooth Camera
features:
This script make your camera movement smooth and improve your gameplay experience.

Smooth Camera V2 :
• Imoroved Smooth Camera Motion
• added Smooth FOV transition (lerp)
• added Camera Shake - it will triggered if on damage, Landing (fall) and nearby explosions
• Subtle head bobbing effect for immersion (W.I.P)

[FULLY OPTIMIZED PC & MOBILE]

m.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,s)if s==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then n(0.8)end end)
end

local function t(u)p(u)end

d.CharacterAdded:Connect(t)if d.Character then p(d.Character)end

i=i:Lerp(w,f*v)
if k>0 then
local x=Vector3.new(math.random(-100,100)/100*k,math.random(-100,100)/100*k,math.random(-100,100)/100*k)
i=i*CFrame.new(x)
k=math.max(k-l*v,0)
end
local y=tick()
local z=Vector3.new(math.sin(y*2)*0.05,math.abs(math.cos(y*2))*0.03,0)
i=i*CFrame.new(z)
e.FieldOfView=e.FieldOfView+(j-e.FieldOfView)*g*v
e.CFrame=i
end)

workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(_)
